title: OpenAI Provider: Core Implementation
description:
Implement the full OpenAI Chat Completions API provider in internal/ai/provider/openai/. Follows Anthropic patterns.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Plan: docs/plans/03-provider-openai.md (all sections)

Key deliverables:
- provider.go, request.go: Message conversion, developer role via ModelCompat, tool schema with strict mode
- compat.go: All 12 ModelCompat flags from §6.1 matrix (store, developer role, reasoning effort, streaming usage, etc.)
- stream.go: Stream/StreamSimple with reasoning effort mapping for o-series models
- sse_parser.go: SSE event loop, [DONE] sentinel, per-choice processing, streaming usage
- tool_json_parser.go: Index-based multi-tool delta parsing, deterministic finalization order (sort by index), strict parse
- usage.go: OpenAI usage mapping, stop reason mapping
- errors.go: Error classification for OpenAI + compat endpoints (Cerebras, Mistral)
- types_wire.go: Wire structs
- Unit tests (all ModelCompat flags), component tests (GPT-4o, o3, multi-tool, Groq/Mistral fixtures), integration tests
- All tests pass with -race, make check clean

Implementation guide: §1.1, §1.3, §4.6

Depends on: Anthropic Core (aiag-jj7.2) — pattern leader
